nets.name: FDARS Wednesday Evening Net
nets.notes: General chat and local radio discussion. All licensed operators welcome.

nets.name: FDARS Sunday Morning Net
nets.notes: Informal local net on simplex. Good for a casual Sunday morning chat.

nets.name: East Suffolk 4m Net
nets.notes: Open to all licensed operators. A great way to use the 4m band.

nets.name: REF079C D-STAR Net
nets.notes: Regular D-STAR net used by operators across Suffolk and surrounding areas. Newcomers welcome — listening in first is perfectly fine before joining the conversation.
